children: EQT AB (OMXSTO:EQT) is reshaping its private markets and insurance footprint, completing a $3.2bn Coller Capital acquisition to form Coller EQT and agreeing to buy McGill and Partners for $2.0bn, while repurchasing 680,980 shares under its ongoing buyback program.
: EQT completed acquisition of Coller Capital, buying management company, GP entities and 10% carry in latest secondaries fund for $3.2bn in EQT shares; combined firm will operate as Coller EQT.
EQT AB Buys McGill And Partners
: EQT AB agreed to buy specialty (re)insurance broker McGill and Partners from Warburg Pincus for $2.0 billion, covering McGill’s specialty (re)insurance brokerage business.
EQT AB Share Repurchases Nasdaq Stockholm
: Aug 24–28, 2026: EQT AB repurchased 680,980 shares on Nasdaq Stockholm under its May 12 buyback program (max 4,368,899 shares, SEK 2.5bn), executed by SEB.
